_comment: Frozen per-category vision-encoder stress weights in [0,1] (higher = more encoder-stressing). Tiers are derived from the perception literature (dense fine-detail, OCR/text, scientific micro/macro imagery stress encoders; natural-scene semantics do not) and CORROBORATED by per-img_type accuracy of glm-4.5v on the 660 shipped MMMU rows (hardest: Chemical Structures 0.52, Body Scans 0.59, Medical 0.61, Microscopic 0.63; easiest: Photographs 0.82, Paintings 0.82, Maps 0.92, Sculpture 1.0). The table is a CATEGORY-LEVEL prior applied uniformly to all models/items and never reads the target model's scores, so it generalizes to an unseen model.
